mapper.select: SELECT w.want_id AS wantId, w.want_time AS wantTime, p.project_id AS projectId, s.session_id AS sessionId, p.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, p.title AS title, p.poster_url AS posterUrl, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, v.venue_name AS venueName, s.start_time AS startTime, COALESCE(s.min_price, p.min_price) AS minPrice, COALESCE(s.max_price, p.max_price) AS maxPrice, p.want_count AS wantCount FROM want_record w JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = w.project_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = ( SELECT s1.session_id FROM performance_session s1 WHERE s1.project_id = p.project_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN s1.start_time >= NOW() THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, CASE WHEN s1.start_time >= NOW() THEN s1.start_time END ASC, CASE WHEN s1.start_time < NOW() THEN s1.start_time END DESC, s1.session_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.want_time DESC, w.want_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_project WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND project_status != 'OFFLINE'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO want_record (user_id, project_id, want_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{projectId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE performance_project SET want_count = want_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
UPDATE performance_project SET want_count = GREATEST(want_count - 1, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
